title: Refactor plan-kind catalog needs bounded field projection and pagination
wanted_capability: An isolate-friendly plan-kind catalog API that can return only kind/backend/safety/required_schema/examples for a requested language, with pagination or projection, without hitting MCP response caps or requiring parsing large previews.
fallback_used: Filtered to language=rust and manually reduced the JSON inside exec; unfiltered all-language catalog returned response_too_large.
notes: Observed all-language bbox_refactor_plan_kinds response_too_large at 100862 bytes over an 81920 cap while exploring isolate usage.
resolution_note: Partially met: RefactorPlanKindsParams (crates/bbox-refactor/src/lib.rs:148) already supports projection-by-filter (language/safety_class/backend), and add_plan_kind_group (:1552) emits compact per-kind records (no large previews). Remaining ask (offset/limit pagination, field-level projection) is deliberately not pursued: the v1 bbox_refactor_plan_kinds catalog is CLOSED and on the kill list (decision af3c4783 "Refactor tooling is harness-native; daemon refactor surfaces retire with no bridge" + b8dc263d; bbox-refactor/AGENTS.md). The harness-native future (bro-harness cell bindings code.*/edits.*/java.*) does not consume this catalog — they are thin adapters over `plan`. Adding pagination to a retiring endpoint is moot investment.
